info.name: OpenTripMap Geographic coordinates of populated place API

params.name: lang
params.description: Two-letter language code (ISO639-1). The following values are available: en (english), ru (russian)

params.name: country
params.description: Two-letter country code, ISO-3166 (optional). Default is all countries.

items.docs: Returns geographic coordinates for the given placename (region, city, village, etc.). The method returns the place whose name is most similar to the search string. Service based on GeoNames database.
